# #1758: Patch: a failed settings save to the account says so and offers Try again
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Settings like "confirm end turn" save to your account in the background. When that save fails today, it fails silently: you change a setting, the account copy never updates, and the only recovery is an automatic retry you never see. After the change the settings panel shows a quiet "settings didn't save to your account" line with a Try again button.

## Why

`settings/accountSync.ts` already tracks the sync as `signedOut | syncing | saved | error` (lines 31-38) and exports `useSettingsSyncState` and `retrySettingsSync` (lines 62-68) — both tested — but no production code consumes either: the sync engine is mounted (`main.tsx:467`, `routes/practice.tsx:644`, `routes/landing.tsx:366`) and writes happen, while the failure state and the retry are dead exports. `SettingsPanel.tsx` renders no sync state at all. A failed write is invisible until the automatic retry on tab visibility/online fires (`accountSync.ts:291-307`).

## Proposal

A status line in the settings panel bound to `useSettingsSyncState`, plus a Try again calling `retrySettingsSync` — no new sync machinery, only consuming what is already built and tested.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/settings/SettingsPanel.tsx` and `apps/web/src/settings/accountSync.ts` (the exports it needs already exist); vitest beside `SettingsPanel`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A failed account sync surfaces the notice with Try again
- [ ] Try again retries and the notice clears on success
- [ ] No notice while `syncing`, `saved` or `signedOut`
- [ ] The automatic retry behaviour is unchanged

## Size and risks

Small — the state machine, the states and the retry already exist and are tested; the patch is presentation wiring only.
